story.iWant: React Router v7 and react-i18next configured with client-side routing and bilingual support
story.soThat: the app has proper navigation between pages and users can switch between English and Vietnamese languages

tasks.task: Install React Router v7 - npm install react-router-dom
Install i18n dependencies - npm install react-i18next i18next
Configure i18next - Create src/i18n/config.ts with i18next initialization
Migrate existing translation files - Preserve all existing keys from en.json and vi.json
Create route structure - Create src/app/routes.tsx with route definitions
Update App.tsx with Router - Add BrowserRouter, Routes, Route
Create language sync hook - Create src/hooks/useLanguageSync.ts
Verify implementation - npm run dev without errors

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: React Router v7 is installed - npm list react-router-dom shows 7.x
react-i18next and i18next are installed - npm list react-i18next i18next shows versions
Routes are configured for: /, /guide, /downloads, /devices, /support - Navigating to each URL renders correct page
i18next is configured with en.json and vi.json - i18n.options.resources contains both locales
Existing translation keys are preserved and migrated - All keys from original files exist
useTranslation hook works in components - Calling t('key') returns translated text
Language can be switched via settingsStore - Changing settingsStore.language updates i18next language
npm run dev runs without TypeScript errors - Dev server starts successfully

constraints.constraint: DO NOT modify files in src/core/, src/auth/, src/services/ - core logic must remain untouched
Migrate existing translation keys - all keys from en.json and vi.json MUST be preserved
Use BrowserRouter for cleaner URLs - HTTPS hosting supports this

Follow naming conventions: PascalCase for components, camelCase for hooks
Import order: React → Third-party → Stores → Hooks → Components → Types → Utils
